name: August Fehlstart
props: brass squeeze horn with red bulb
personality: He hears the first laugh as confirmation that the plan must have started successfully.
biography: Fehlstart supplies the HyperNorm entrance with a squeeze horn and the optimism necessary to try it again. A card allowing a mistake to remain useful opens his enormous crooked laugh: an audience is either delighted or not yet ready. Hunky & Dory request dependable morale. He squeezes the bulb, hoping the next unexpected sound will turn out to have been intentional.
note: Der Auftakt ist erfolgt. Seine Übereinstimmung mit dem Plan wird nachträglich angenommen.

name: Madame Punktgenau
props: ivory cone hat with black pom-poms
humour: ceremonial superiority / perfectionism undermined by timing
personality: She will permit spontaneous amusement as soon as its timing has been approved.
biography: Punktgenau balances a red ball in the HyperNorm rehearsal corner while holding the baton below an already disapproving lip. A card suggesting that delight can arrive without permission receives her narrowest glance: a performance is either precise or an interruption. Men in Black appreciate discipline. note: Die Heiterkeit ist zugelassen. Ihr Eintritt bedarf noch des richtigen Augenblicks.

name: Pierrot Vielleicht
personality: He has brought a small hopeful gesture and is trying not to place unreasonable demands on it.
biography: Vielleicht keeps a drooping flower upright in the HyperNorm waiting area with both hands and very little certainty. A card allowing sorrow and affection to occupy the same gesture deepens his lower lip: a feeling is either sincere or badly performed. Hunky & Dory request a brighter atmosphere. note: Die Hoffnung wurde mitgebracht. Ihre Haltung bleibt vorläufig nachgiebig.

name: Colombina Nebenwitz
props: small red cap with teal bow
personality: She lets the audience finish the dangerous half of the joke and keeps the fan below her actual expression.
biography: Nebenwitz attends the HyperNorm reception with a fan at her belly and a little mask hanging well away from her uncovered eyes. note: Die Andeutung ist vollständig. Der ausgesprochene Teil wurde dem Publikum überlassen.

name: Harlekin Umspiel

note: Der Ablauf wurde eingehalten. Seine Reihenfolge behauptet weiterhin Eigenständigkeit.

name: Hofnarr Wahrmund
props: short marotte with carved wooden dummy head
personality: He tests whether the truth is safer when the wooden version of himself appears to have said it.
biography: Wahrmund carries a smiling wooden marotte into the HyperNorm audience chamber and keeps his own mouth considerably less settled. A card allowing criticism to remain loyal sends his eyes upward: a truth is either a punchline or poorly timed. Men in Black permit appropriate ridicule. He gives the rattle the first turn, hoping authority may find a carved smile easier to hear.
note: Die Bemerkung war zulässig. Der Holzkollege übernimmt vorsorglich den Wortlaut.
